bio.text: George "Chip" Tangen, of Inver Grove Heights, is the Libertarian candidate for Minnesota secretary of state in 2026; the KAXE candidate survey response lists employment as a relationship manager at Enterprise Minnesota.

In the KAXE candidate survey response, Tangen listed political science and law degrees from Middlebury College and the University of Minnesota and service as legislative counsel to U.S. Rep. Jim Ramstad.
